name: inquiry-resolution-plan
supersedes: inquiry-resolution-plan/v3 (used by the WP-1 diagnostic); v1 and v2 were withdrawn before use

label_policy.author: designer; vocabulary and frozen rows adopted by the product owner on 2026-09-20 (DEV/CALIBRATION — never a holdout)
label_policy.steps: CLOSES = an authority allowed to close the need; PRECONDITION = must be read before it; CONTEXT = read, never closes. Each step also names the instance it is about (scope) and, for a procedure, the change it makes (effect). A fallback to the seller is not a step.
label_policy.expected_terminal: where the need ends once every system step the CURRENT registry offers has run on snapshot S0's knowledge — listing detail acquisition included, no image reader, no procedure executor, today's order connectors. Not the immediate next step: a need whose listing detail was never read is 'acquire first' now and ends here after it. ACQUIRABLE and UNREADABLE_SOURCE are POSSIBLE gaps (a source exists that was not or cannot be read); the gold uses UNREADABLE_SOURCE only where the designer knows the answer is in that source.
label_policy.pending: PENDING_ADJUDICATION rows carry the proposal and alternatives and are excluded from every score until the product owner decides

holds: real inquiry id prefixes and the designer's plan labels; no customer or seller text

adjudication.R:f81ad84a.n1: ENTITY_STATE only — a tracking/fulfilment lookup is a read, not a procedure; with no linked order it is a capability gap and then a seller handoff
adjudication.S:N6.n1: KNOWLEDGE (company policy) — with no such knowledge the runtime goes to the seller, and the gold stays KNOWLEDGE so that a policy taught once is reused
adjudication.invariant: PROCEDURE is never used for a plain read/answer: when reading entity state resolves the request the plan ends at ENTITY_STATE; a procedure is required only for an external state change or a bounded business workflow
